newsitem.title: UK: UK's Clarke says rate debate outcome uncertain.
newsitem.headline: UK's Clarke says rate debate outcome uncertain.

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said on Thursday it remained uncertain if he or Bank of England Governor Eddie George would be proved correct about UK interest rates.

"We still don't know which of us is actually right. Eddie and I agree it is a matter of judgement and we will probably never know," he said in an article in the moderate Tory Bow Group's magazine, Crossbow.
Minutes from the last two monetary meetings have shown George would prefer to see UK base rates at 6.00 percent not 5.75.
